hooks.name: agent-review-guard
hooks.description: While docs/agent-review/.review-mode exists, block writes outside docs/agent-review/, network and state-changing shell commands, and MCP or web tools. Delete the flag file to turn it off (Phase 6).

hooks.name: agent-review-citation-check
hooks.description: After the agent saves a deliverable under docs/agent-review/, check that its file:line citations point at real lines and that findings have their required fields.
